First project-code statement that consumes the attacker-controlled document bytes for the vulnerable DOS EPS header probe.

The patch captures `const size_t read = fread(...)` and adds `read == 4` as the leftmost conjunct. In the vulnerable code, the return value is discarded, so a short read still reaches the next byte comparison on partially initialized stack storage.
